## 7. Technical Constraints

| Constraint | Requirement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Performance** | LCP < 2.5s, bundle < 300KB gzipped |
| **Responsive** | Mobile-first, breakpoints: 640/768/1024/1280px |
| **Browsers** | Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge (latest 2 versions) |
| **Wallet Support** | MetaMask, WalletConnect, Trust Wallet |
| **Animation Budget** | Max 3 GSAP timelines per page (performance) |
| **Image Format** | WebP, max 200KB per image, hero max 500KB |
| **Fonts** | Max 2 font families, WOFF2 format, subset characters |
| **Accessibility** | WCAG 2.1 AA minimum, keyboard navigable |
| **Dark Mode** | Required / Optional / Not needed |
| **i18n** | Required (languages: [list]) / English only |
